Here is a list of Nobel Prize winners whose last name rhymes with their first name:

1. Doris Lessing (Literature, 2007)
2. Saul Bellow (Literature, 1976)
3. Roald Dahl (Literature, 1983)
4. Marie Curie (Physics, 1903; Chemistry, 1911)
5. William Faulkner (Literature, 1949)
6. Boris Pasternak (Literature, 1958)
7. Harold Pinter (Literature, 2005)
8. Giorgos Seferis (Literature, 1963)
9. Rabindranath Tagore (Literature, 1913)
10. William Yeats (Literature, 1923)
